integrity: A self-contained proof of the explicit presentation, infinitesimal support, tangent excess, and point counts is supplied; same-model review only, independent validation not performed. The first_public_date records the earliest specifically verified online-publication day used for a directly relevant 16W10 source, rather than a repository placeholder date or a journal year.
limitations: The scheme is the explicitly defined reversal-inner parameter scheme, not an asserted functorial identification with the entire involution functor on every nonreduced base.
Earlier classification literature over fields and commutative rings remains a historical priority risk, including inaccessible full texts.
The theorem does not classify conjugacy orbits or involutions on general incidence algebras.
The supporting finite-field computations are not proofs of infinite generality.
title: Embedded characteristic-two deformation locus of upper-triangular algebra involutions
